<?php
/**
 * Astra Free Lab — presentation styles only.
 */
add_action('wp_head', function () {
    if (is_admin()) return;
    ?>
    <style>
      :root{--lab-ink:#171713;--lab-paper:#f4f0e8;--lab-pine:#1f4d47;--lab-steel:#6f6a62;--lab-rule:#d4cec3}
      body{background:var(--lab-paper);color:var(--lab-ink)}
      .ast-container{max-width:1180px}
      .lab-shell{max-width:980px;margin:0 auto}
      .lab-kicker{text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.14em;font-size:.72rem;color:var(--lab-steel);font-weight:600}
      .lab-hero{padding:clamp(4rem,10vw,8rem) 0 4rem}
      .lab-hero h1{font-size:clamp(3.2rem,8vw,6.6rem);line-height:.93;letter-spacing:-.045em;max-width:10ch;margin:.7rem 0 1.4rem}
      .lab-hero .lead{font-size:clamp(1.05rem,2vw,1.35rem);line-height:1.45;max-width:48rem;color:var(--lab-steel)}
      .lab-rule{height:1px;background:var(--lab-rule);margin:3rem 0}
      .lab-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:1px;background:var(--lab-rule);border:1px solid var(--lab-rule)}
      .lab-card{background:var(--lab-paper);padding:2rem;min-height:230px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:space-between;transition:.2s ease}
      .lab-card:hover{background:var(--lab-pine);color:var(--lab-paper)}
      .lab-card h2{font-size:1.8rem;line-height:1.05;margin:1.25rem 0 .65rem}
      .lab-card p{font-size:.94rem;line-height:1.55;color:var(--lab-steel);margin:0}
      .lab-card:hover p{color:rgba(244,240,232,.82)}
      .lab-cta{display:flex;gap:1rem;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:2rem}
      .lab-cta a{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-height:48px;padding:0 1.25rem;text-decoration:none}
      .lab-primary{background:var(--lab-pine);color:var(--lab-paper)}
      .lab-secondary{border:1px solid var(--lab-ink);color:var(--lab-ink)}
      .lab-section{padding:4rem 0}
      .lab-section h2{font-size:clamp(2.3rem,5vw,4rem);line-height:1;margin:0 0 1rem;letter-spacing:-.03em}
      .lab-section .intro{max-width:48rem;color:var(--lab-steel);line-height:1.6}
      .lab-split{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:3rem;align-items:start}
      .lab-list{border-top:1px solid var(--lab-rule)}
      .lab-item{display:grid;grid-template-columns:7rem 1fr;gap:1.5rem;padding:1.35rem 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--lab-rule)}
      .lab-item strong{color:var(--lab-pine)}
      .lab-small{color:var(--lab-steel);font-size:.9rem;line-height:1.55}
      @media(max-width:800px){.lab-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.lab-split{grid-template-columns:1fr}.lab-hero h1{max-width:11ch}}
    </style>
    <?php
});
